pokedexEntries.su: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

pokedexEntries.mo: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

pokedexEntries.us: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.

pokedexEntries.um: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

pokedexEntries.sc: Using its beak to strike 16 times per second, it opens holes in even the hardest of trees.

pokedexEntries.vi: Pikipek has strong muscles in its neck, so it won’t hurt itself even if it violently shakes its head.
